meta.name: Being Gordon Ramsay
meta.description:
Follow Gordon Ramsay over 9 months in the lead up to his biggest restaurant venture to date: the opening of 5 culinary experiences in London's 22 Bishopsgate, the City of London's tallest building.

Rated TV-MA · Returning Series · First aired 18 Feb 2026 · United Kingdom · Language: English
Studio: Studio Ramsay Global · Network: Netflix

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: With just 22 weeks until the big opening, Gordon stirs up plans for a bold pre-launch party. At home, his daughter Tilly prepares for a dream prospect.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Gordon flies to Las Vegas to land a pulse-racing contract. In London, Holly makes an exciting announcement — but 22 Bishopsgate hits a major roadblock.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: As the reality of a recent setback sinks in, pressures mount on the success of RGR High. Gordon carves out some tender family time with Tana and the kids.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: With three weeks till launch, Gordon goes to extremes to promote 22 Bishopsgate. Later, he jets to the Philippines for a chaotic yet inspiring opening.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Gordon opens up about fame and parental guilt. Meanwhile, simmering tensions between kitchen staff and builders threaten to ruin the long-awaited launch.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: After a messy soft launch, Gordon's team have issues to fix — and just 12 hours till guests arrive. Can they turn up the heat when it matters the most?
